questions.question: When Jeremiah offered the Rechabites wine in the house of the LORD, why did they refuse to drink it?

answers.text: Their forefather told them never to drink it
Their forefather told them to drink only at feasts
Their forefather told them to drink only at home

questions.question: As their forefather Jonadab commanded, where did the Rechabites live all their lives instead of in houses?
Through Jeremiah, God told the people of Judah that He had spoken to them only once.
Because the Rechabites obeyed their forefather Jonadab, what did God promise Jonadab's family?

answers.text: A man to stand before God always
Fields and vineyards of their own
